payload.reason: The evidence provides specific statistical improvements of the PAMPO model over existing alternatives in named entity recognition, indicating a clear enhancement in performance metrics.

claims.text: PAMPO improves named entity recognition by at least 0.25 over AlchemyAPI, Rembrandt, and Zemanta.
PAMPO achieves significantly higher recall and F1 measures compared to AlchemyAPI, Rembrandt, and Zemanta.
PAMPO's performance is at least as good as the best existing systems and better than others when excluding dates and numeric expressions.
PAMPO increases the value of a specific performance metric from 0.72 to 0.87.
